name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Stable raid runtime, native wild-controller combat and the authoritative 6000-unit arena remain enabled. The visible boundary is now a 32-character crowd ring using the proven UPalNPCManager::SpawnNPCForServer path: 16 generic human NPCs and 16 Pals alternate around the arena, face inward, and are continuously forced invulnerable, non-colliding, movement-disabled, neutral, AI-suppressed and uncapturable where applicable. Vanilla character emote montages are broadcast where available. Previous invisible/crashing visual backends remain disabled. No client installation required.
